journey.name: fixed quoted request confirmation
journey.description: Two linked test wallets with Paykit enabled. The payer has existing Bitcoin regtest funds; no mainnet payment is needed. Use a USD-denominated request with fixed BTC conversion terms. Reuse the existing confirmation layout and close before paying. On iOS, requests offering both LNURL and Savings keep the Amount funding-source selection because LNURL confirmation has no wallet selector; Android offers that choice in its common confirmation view.

actions.action: Disable USDT on the payer. Create a fixed 2.50 USD request accepting Savings, then open it on the payer.

Verify Preparing changes directly to Confirm without showing a disabled Amount keypad. While funding setup or coin selection is pending, try the payment swipe and verify no PIN, biometric prompt or hardware signing opens. Verify the exact BTC amount follows the request quote, the fiat equivalent uses the payer wallet rate, and the selected coins and fee are prepared before payment is enabled.

Choose a non-default automatic coin-selection setting, open a fixed quoted Savings request and verify the selected coins and fee follow that setting. Close, choose manual coin selection and reopen; verify the coin picker appears before payment can be approved. Go Back without selecting coins and verify Confirm stays open, allowing a funding change. Swipe again and verify coin selection is still required. On iOS, select coins and continue, then go Back through the coin picker to the original Confirm and verify its fee is recalculated. Close without paying.

On iOS, reuse a paired hardware test wallet with sufficient existing funds and a payer with empty Savings. Open a fixed BTC Savings-only request using automatic coin selection. Verify setup settles on hardware Confirm with a fee, without an Amount detour. Close, select manual coins and reopen; verify hardware Confirm remains usable without opening an empty Savings picker. Repeat both modes with a fixed USD-to-BTC quote. Close without signing or paying; verify each unpaid request can be reopened.
Verify the requested amount cannot be edited and payment does not start without the confirmation swipe. Close the sheet and verify the unpaid request remains available to reopen.
Reopen the same request, then close while Preparing is visible. Verify late completion does not reopen the sheet or start a payment. Reopen once more and verify confirmation is usable.
Open a request whose BTC amount exceeds the payer balance. Verify payment cannot be authorized. Close without paying.
Open a request with a short payment deadline. Let it expire before swiping and verify no payment is sent. Verify fresh payment terms must be reviewed before a retry can proceed.
Enable USDT and open a request accepting both Bitcoin and USDT. Verify the existing asset-selection screen remains available. Close without paying.

With USDT enabled, open a request accepting Savings and BOLT11 Spending only. Verify it still opens directly to Confirm. If both Bitcoin rails are available, switch between Spending and Savings. Verify valid quoted terms stay on Confirm with the new exact BTC amount and refreshed fees, and still require a swipe. Verify unavailable or expired terms, or a Lightning amount below its minimum, return to Amount for review. On iOS, go Back from that fallback Amount and verify the sheet closes without reopening Amount; reopen the unpaid request and verify the funding choices remain available. Repeat using the interactive edge-swipe Back gesture.

With USDT disabled, open a fixed USD request offering LNURL Spending and Savings with different quoted amounts. Verify Amount offers both wallets and choosing either shows its exact quoted amount. Continue with Spending and verify LNURL confirmation shows that amount; close without paying. Reopen, choose Savings and continue; verify Bitcoin confirmation shows the Savings quote and fee. Close without paying. Repeat with an LNURL-only request whose quote meets its endpoint minimum and verify it goes directly to LNURL confirmation without Amount.

On iOS with USDT disabled, open a Savings-only fixed quote for 546 sats. Verify Amount is the first usable screen, Continue is disabled and the sheet remains open after setup finishes. Close and repeat with Savings selected initially because BOLT11 Spending cannot pay; verify the same result. Repeat with exactly 547 sats and sufficient existing funds for fees; verify direct Confirm. Close without paying.

On iOS, open an LNURL-only fixed quote one sat below the endpoint minimum. Verify Amount remains open with Continue disabled after setup finishes. Close and repeat at exactly the minimum with sufficient Spending balance; verify direct LNURL confirmation. Close without paying.

On iOS, use a fixed Savings-only quote covered by the existing balance but leaving too little for its fee. With automatic coin selection, verify coin-preparation failure returns to Amount. Tap the top-bar Back arrow and verify the sheet closes without reopening Amount or repeating the failure toast. Reopen the unpaid request and verify it is still available. Close without paying.
